uniqueness_obstruction.theorem: Charge-allowed portal moduli Y have positive dimension. Q_proj=I-4W(Y) depends on Y, so the map (Y,tanβ)→(C_e,C_p,C_n) is not injective. Unique C_f cannot follow from Z17 charges alone.

aligned_benchmark_at_shared_tan_beta.note: These C_f values assume Q_proj=I. Misaligned portals produce different mass-basis charges and can induce FCNCs.

axioms.name: maximal_aligned_hierarchical_uv_completion_v20
axioms: A1: generation-universal lam_Q_F and vanishing generation-dependent Phi light-heavy Yukawas
A2: hierarchical Q portal with lam_Q_R = lam_S_Q_Rbar = 0
A3: exact alignment limit ε→0 (equivalently W=0, Q_proj=I)
A4: O(1) UV magnitudes fixed to the manuscript benchmark y_P=y_R=y_Q=1
A5: tan(beta) selected as the global chi2 minimum of the corrected free-v_R flavour fit among viable points
A6: central di Cortona/PDG hadronic matching for C_p,C_n (envelope reported separately)
axioms.scope: These axioms are an explicit UV completion choice. They are not implied by Z17 charge assignments. Unique C_f under this set is conditional, not unconditional.

alignment_diagnostics.note: Finite ε gives approximate alignment. Exact uniqueness of the aligned formulas requires the strict W=0 locus in A3.

roadmap.honest_summary: The pipeline is a rigorously tested, fail-closed candidate with channel-level FCNC rates and official NA62/TWIST comparisons. Full certification as a unique UV theory is blocked by a mathematical uniqueness obstruction unless additional UV axioms are adopted, and by unfinished PS/two-loop and real 37 GHz data.
